subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Redwood + Verbio Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@verbio.health>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Redwood + Verbio Health

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Recap
- Primary use case: real-time patient triage chat + clinical summarization for intake notes.
- Current baseline: ~120 QPS peak (see attached CSV) with spiky bursts up to ~350 QPS during peak hours.
- Target latency: p95 <= 250ms for short prompts (<= 256 tokens), p95 <= 500ms for longer summarization flows.
- Data controls: PHI will be present; customer needs private deployment or VPC with KMS integration.

What we propose for next step
- Schedule a Dedicated Capacity Sizing call (technical deep dive) to validate throughput/latency targets, model selection, quantization options, and deployment topology.
- Attendees: your infra/ML engineer(s), product (Sam/Kate), and our engineering lead (Dev Patel) + me.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tuesday 8/30 10:00—11:00
- Wednesday 8/31 09:00—10:00

If neither works, share a couple of windows or the team calendar link and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short capacity_sizing_template.xlsx — please fill in QPS distribution and typical payload sizes if convenient; it will make the call more productive.

Agenda for sizing call (30—60m)
- Quick recap + goals (5m)
- Traffic profile & prompt/sequence length review (10m)
- Model options & quantization tradeoffs (10m)
- Deployment topology and failover/burst strategy (10—20m)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.ai
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@verbio.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Lin <kate.lin@verbio.health>
Date: 2026-08-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Redwood + Verbio Health

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. We can do Tue 8/30 morning. Who from your side will be on the call? Dev, are you able to join?

Quick FYI — attached is our export of recent traffic (verbio_qps_export.csv). Peak of ~345 QPS last Thursday; typical day is ~90—130 QPS. We do have multi-region routing needs (US primary, EU backup) but for the sizing call we can focus on the US footprint.

A couple of questions for the meeting:
- Can Redwood support burst capacity to 3x baseline for short windows?
- Do you recommend a specific model family for mixed short-response & longer summarization tasks?

Sam
Sam Walters
Head of Product, Verbio Health
sam.walters@verbio.health | +1 (617) 555-3321
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@verbio.health>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-28T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Redwood + Verbio Health

Great — we’ll plan for Tue 8/30 10:00—11:00 PT.

Attendees from our side: Dev Patel (Engineering Lead, serving/runtime), me (sales), and I’ll loop in Marcus Lin (Solutions Engineer) if we need deeper kernel/quantization discussion.

On your questions:
- Burst capacity: yes — Redwood Dedicated supports configured burst pools and automatic overflow policies; we’ll review recommended sizing on the call and show how autoscaling + burst buffers behave under spiky traffic.
- Model family: we’ll bring a short model recommendation matrix (small/fast vs. large/high-quality) and run a few latency estimates based on your payload sizes.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123 (I’ve tentatively added your team). Please accept if that works. I’ve also uploaded a short pre-read (pre-read.pdf) with a few example topologies we commonly use for similar healthcare customers.

If you can, please populate the capacity_sizing_template.xlsx with the typical request size distribution (tokens/request) and QPS by time window — that will let us produce an initial sizing recommendation before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@verbio.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Redwood + Verbio Health

Thanks Sam/Marissa — confirmed for 10:00 PT. A couple of quick asks from the engineering side so we can prepare:

- Peak QPS (from CSV) looks consistent; can you confirm 1-hour and 10-minute peak counts?
- Typical prompt length (tokens) for the triage chat vs. summarization flows (ballpark is fine).
- Any special compliance constraints (SOC2 type II, retention windows) beyond PHI handling we should know now.

We’ll run a quick load projection and bring a few config examples (batching, KV cache strategy, quantization level) to the call.

See you Tuesday.

—
Dev Patel
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
